1.explanation: src/ol/source/GeoTIFF.js is where the GeoTIFFSource’s wrapX/cropping and nodata handling are configured for direct (unreprojected) tiles. src/ol/reproj/DataTile.js implements the ReprojDataTile loader that fetches and clips source tiles for reprojection, but it does not respect the GeoTIFFSource’s crop (wrapX/nodata) settings. As a result, cropped extents are lost under reprojection and need to be applied in ReprojDataTile.
1.bug_scenario: The user has a GeoTIFF layer with a non-zero nodata value and expects the source tiles to be cropped to the tile grid extent (using the GeoTIFFSource “wrapX”-style crop), even when the map view is reprojected. In the provided screenshot, tiles rendered under a reprojection extend outside the original tile grid (showing unwanted data and empty borders) instead of being clipped to the grid.
